title: E-FRC-0290: 't Hooft matching on both walls of the chiral slab with every input read from the register rule: the...
purpose: Experiment E-FRC-0290 in the gauge arena: 't Hooft matching on both walls of the chiral slab with every input read from the register rule: the walls are 3+1d, face A reads hand +1 and face B -1, each an SU(2)+ doublet, the tones carry conjugate colour so only like-tone triples are singlets, R* keeps N+ = $N_A + N_B$ and SU(2)+ exactly while the one-wall numbers are broken only by the inter-wall leak; on $S4 = U(1)_Q \times SU(2)_A \times SU(2)_B \times U(1)_V$ the charge-one (1/2, 1/2) doublet at index 1 per tone per wall matches every coefficient.
known_limitations: Depth L1 (L1: known mathematics, correctly confirmed).
